Sahaba Timeline

Every line is one life, in the order they became Muslim, earliest on the left. Slide through time and see who was alive, and roughly how old they were.

Dates are approximate. Sources differ and many births were never recorded, so a fading end means "we are not sure exactly". The stories come from صور من حياة الصحابة, and others from Abdul Wahid Hamid's English book Companions of the Prophet and Mahmood Ahmad Ghadanfar's Great Women of Islam.
